title: Should I BUY an Extended WARRANTY On A USED CAR? | FACTS
summary: A general-interest car reviewer explains how long factory warranties last, the bumper-to-bumper vs. powertrain distinction, warranty transferability on used cars, and how to avoid extended-warranty scams.

Lee & Venkataraman's dealership transaction data: the most common basic warranties are 3-years/36,000 miles, 4-years/50,000 miles, and 5-years/60,000 miles, with power-train warranties ranging from two to ten years.
